title: Rotational Grazing for Strong Roots
reason: Explains the method of rotating livestock to mimick wildlife behavior for soil health.

tasks.task: Explain the concept of rotating livestock to mimic wildlife behavior.

subtasks.text: Describe how wildlife, such as buffalo, antelope, and deer, rotated constantly.
Note that before fences, these animals were never in the same area for 40-50 days.

tasks.task: Detail the benefits of rotating livestock for soil health.

subtasks.text: State the goal of creating deep, thick roots and deep soil.
Mention that the only way to achieve deep soil is by rotating livestock.
Highlight the importance of keeping a living root and green grass growing.
